title: The Mane's Braid
summary: Within the sacred forest-basin of Torval, priestly wardens and Ohmes court scribes race to recover a stolen ancestral hair-braid relic before the Two-Moons Procession.

hook.rumour: Pilgrims crowded outside Torval's incense gates whisper that a silver reliquary holding a braid of the First Mane was taken from the Cedar Sanctum during the new-moon eclipse.
hook.notice: PRIESTLY QUARTER OF TORVAL: Trusted walkers of the Two-Moons Path sought to recover the Cedar Reliquary before the Procession of Jone and Jode.

npcs.name: Warden of Torval
npcs.greet: Pilgrims crowded outside Torval's incense gates whisper that a silver reliquary holding a braid of the First Mane was taken from the Cedar Sanctum during the new-moon eclipse.
talk: The trouble across Torval began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Torval.
If you mean to help the Mane's Seat of Torval, start by checking the trail between Torval and Shabaae Mine.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Torval
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Shabaae Mine is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Shabaae Mine toward Havoset Homestead before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Torval so Speaker-for-the-Mane Kha'jirr can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Havoset Homestead
npcs.greet: You made good time from Shabaae Mine. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Tasha.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Tasha with a picked guard.
Once Tasha is cleared, return to Torval to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Torval
npcs.greet: Speaker-for-the-Mane Kha'jirr awaits word on whether the crisis in Torval has been contained.
talk: The elders of Torval have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Torval owes you a debt for standing between Torval and ruin.

story_torval_boss_06.name: Usurper-Captain of Shrine Clavicus Vile Elsweyr (6)
